intro: Monday brings cloud automation for developers, a fatal Fraser Valley fire and renewed Canada–U.S. trade discussions. November planning includes Icelandic music and cooking, an AI programming lab and an opportunity to demonstrate a local agent.

stories.title: Agent Merge watches pull requests in the cloud
stories.summary: Paid Copilot users can now activate Agent Merge from a pull request’s merge box. Choose failing workflows, merge conflicts or both; Copilot starts a cloud development environment when those blockers appear, subject to organization policies.

stories.title: Actions adds AWS capacity alongside Azure
stories.summary: Eligible GitHub-hosted Linux jobs can now run on AWS using existing runner labels and workflow syntax. Teams should synchronize network allowlists with GitHub’s published runner ranges; Enterprise Cloud customers must opt into the additional provider.

stories.title: Webhook receivers need three additional network ranges
stories.summary: GitHub added three webhook delivery ranges to its Meta API: 9.234.98.160/28, 9.234.98.176/28 and 9.234.106.48/28. Administrators maintaining static inbound allowlists should add them to prevent rejected deliveries; allowlists synchronized with the API already receive the additions.

stories.title: A talking garage door offers a voice-agent recipe
stories.summary: NVIDIA’s MonsterHouse walkthrough combines speech recognition, Nemotron reasoning, speech synthesis and facial animation on one workstation. The interactive projection demonstrates how reusable voice-agent components can coordinate conversation, character animation and visitor recognition in a physical installation.

stories.title: Fatal Chilliwack fire displaces other residents
stories.summary: One person died in Friday’s house fire on the 9800 block of Young Road, Chilliwack firefighters confirmed. Extensive fire, smoke and water damage prevented other residents from returning that night; the origin and cause remain under investigation.

stories.title: Carney says trade teams will continue discussions
stories.summary: Mark Carney reported another conversation with Donald Trump on Sunday, saying their teams would keep working toward a trade deal. No agreement was announced; formal talks stalled in August, and Carney described progress last week as limited.

stories.title: Propose a local-agent demo for Vancouver AI
stories.summary: Vancouver AI’s November 25 gathering invites community demos through its participation link. Propose a Nekoni phone-access walkthrough and share https://github.com/nekonihq/nekoni so interested builders can explore the local agent and star the repository if useful.
